A Bough for the Fallen

You kneel, and a cradle of roots lifts your companion as warmth drains from your hands.

Rules

Action: Main Action · Attribute: Reason

Target / range / shape: One willing creature within 3 squares.

Roots gently lift the fallen. Pay 3 HP first, leaving yourself above 0; cost bypasses resistance. Requires a free hand. Life resistance reduces healing, minimum 1.

- Weak: Restore 5 HP. - Standard: Restore 9 HP; the target may stand without spending movement. - Strong: Restore 13 HP; the target may stand without spending movement, then move 1 square without provoking.

Duration: Instant. Applied conditions follow their normal duration and decay.

Equipment / acquisition: No item needed unless named above.

---

Tier / minimum level: 3 · DP: 4 · Requirements to learn: Life 2 and Wilderness 1

Type: Magic / Recovery

Limits: Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.

ID: a-bough-for-the-fallen

Build this character · @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.0bf4c8ad89113132.JournalEntryPage.c0c043f22d65aa20]{Card conventions}

Offensive healing — latest agreement: this spell may target an unwilling creature harmed by healing. Resolve it as an attack using its printed attribute, range, action and HP cost; the HP result becomes Life damage, without beneficial recovery riders. This is the explicit exception to willing-only targeting above. Use the creature’s printed defense when a player defends; no opposed second roll.
